reviews.text: At this  difficult time of letting go of my pup Chiquita. The staff and doctor, were very comforting and explain the whole process. Also thank you the guy that went out of his way to find where to put my pup’s hair and the card with her paw prints and nose print. It means the world to me. Thank you.

Arrived at 11 PM after noticing my dog’s eye was partially closed from irritation. The staff brought her in right away and returned within five minutes. They let me know everything looked fine and that the vet wouldn't recommend unnecessary tests unless new symptoms appeared. I was in and out in no time. Super clean facility, extremely friendly staff, and deeply respectful of both our time and wallet. Very impressed!

Everyone

Fast professional they kept me updated on how he was doing

I went here late with my dog who had extreme bloat and I was so scared for her as she was sicker than I’ve ever seen her. The VCA staff were so incredibly kind. They had their team look at her and told me that they felt comfortable sending her home with me monitoring her instead of waiting hours because it was a very busy night. Despite being busy, they were kind, patient and answered all my questions. They didn’t even charge me for their time since they didn’t admit her. Later that evening I had concerns and called them and they answered and gave me the care I needed even though I didn’t pay and they owed me nothing. So kind and professional. I am forever grateful.

We recently experienced an emergency and the heartbreaking loss of our beloved fur baby. During such an incredibly difficult and emotional time, Dr. Hernandez, Matthew, and the VCA staff were absolutely wonderful in assisting us.

They showed compassion, patience, and genuine care when we needed it most. Their kindness and professionalism helped us through an experience that was extremely painful for our family. We are truly grateful for the way they treated both our pet and us with such dignity and understanding.

Because my dog experienced several serious health issues, I got to know a few of the vets and the staff and spent quite a bit of time at this location. I cannot say enough good things about everyone at this office. They were all so kind and thoughtful throughout a very difficult time. With their knowledge and care I had 18 more months with my dog than I might have had otherwise. I would highly recommend trusting them with the care of your loved fur babies. A very special thanks to Dr Jeon and the oncology team. I am forever grateful to everyone there!
I was very positively impressed by this visit. Dr. Tung was excellent and so was the team around Ms. Lisa,
Very attentive, compassionate, and helpful to my dog and to my pocketbook. I was very impressed and felt like my dog was in very good hands.
Wonderful experience.

Had my cat taken weekly since she has cancer. The staff and Dr. Mark Jeon have all been professional and very kind with our situation. They have been a major helping hand guiding us through this difficult time. I’m glad to have come to this location, I would also recommend this VCA. Thank you !

Dr Jeon was extremely professional and compassionate, he went above and beyond to thoroughly walk us through a difficult diagnosis and our options. His expertise and empathy made navigating a complicated process feel more manageable.

Extremely expensive, extremely long wait times, and very poor communication. I spent hours waiting while my dog was seriously ill, and payment seemed to be prioritized before treatment. I repeatedly had to call for updates because the hospital did not communicate with me proactively.

I ultimately felt that they cared more about collecting payment than helping my dog. At one point, I asked to move to a larger room, and a vet tech responded, “No, we are not disinfecting a bigger room.”

The next day, I took my dog to Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group, where she was hospitalized for three nights and thankfully recovered. Although the treatment there was also expensive, it was worth every penny. I’m incredibly grateful to them and only wish I had taken her there from the beginning.

Based on my experience, I would avoid this veterinary hospital at all costs.
Thank you for helping my cat. it was professional.
My dog needed liver surgery  and VCA of Woodland Hills, Ca took care of everything. Giselle is doing very well, 19 days after surgery. They did an excellent job. Thank you, Dr Gabriela Cortez.

Everyone we interacted with that evening of Friday, July 24, was amazing.  Wonderful staff!!!

Everything was great...from our initial phone call to inquire about euthanasia for Dolcé...checking in...explanation of the procedure and what to expect...pre/post...everyone was very professional and compassionate...great customer service all around...

We love, VCA. Everything was perfect from reception to vet technicians, doctor assistants and of course, Doctor Jeon himself. We were always welcomed with open arms, love and compassion. Communication was always very open and honest with check ups through text and appointment reminders. Facility is very clean and everything is super organized.
They took such amazing care of my baby from the first consultation day until the last.  Even when we had to go to the emergency room, we were met with urgency, honesty, and love. Always appreciate the doctors and the vet technicians open communication and their understanding of the circumstances we were going through.
We could not have chosen a better place to send our baby. They treat you like family and we appreciate them for everything they’ve done for us. Shout out to the oncology team, we are extremely grateful for their love for Buster🩷

This pet hospital saved my bulldogs life. She had a surgery done at another pet hospital and they returned her to me the same day bleeding from where her incision was done. They had planned to do the surgery in one place and have her recover in another. When I got to the other place my dog was bleeding on the hospitals floor and the other place refused to take her. They literally said “good luck it’s on you we can’t take a Bulldog here it’s to risky.” While two know pet hospitals left me with my Bulldog bleeding out VCA Veterinary specialists of the valley took her in immediately, it was 9pm with no prior notice. They found immediately what was wrong, where she was internally bleeding from brought in an amazing dog surgeon and she saved my dogs life. Honest to God I wouldn’t trust any other “clinic” or “vet” with anything serious with my dog again. They are worth every penny. The confidence that this dr had when she called me over night. Reassuring me that she would stop the bleeding and the confidence she had to know she could care for my dog is priceless. I’m truly grateful a place like this exists, my dog’s alive today because of their love for animals.

We came in for an emergency visit. Our dog was treated for puncture wounds after a coyote attack, and we were seen right away. We appreciated the quality of care, the knowledgeable staff, and their willingness to work with us.

Dr. Hernandez listened to our concerns and took the time to answer our questions. Nicolette was thorough and attentive throughout the visit. Thanks to the team, our dog is recovering comfortably at home.

Dr. Jasper was incredibly kind and patient, sitting with us multiple times to discuss options and answer questions. We made the incredibly difficult decision to say goodbye to Harry, and he handled everything with great care and compassion. We very much appreciated his approach.

We brought Harry in for some scans and we were seen in a timely manner. The staff was patient and kind and explained everything to us thoroughly.

I was so grateful to everyone at this VCA. We were there on July 4, they were unbelievably busy, so it was no surprise we had to wait. I felt they gave our dog incredibly good care, were thoughtful and communicative in their clinical process, everyone was so nice, and ultimately with their help he’s completed healed. Not only that, but they’ve continued to be super responsive and helpful after the fact with navigating our insurance, which feels like going above and beyond.

I strongly recommend requesting a complete copy of your pet's medical records if you use this practice. Do not leave it to chance or procedure.

VCA stated they would follow up with a phone call, but that call never occurred per referring veterinary office. The lack of communication and verification led to recommendations for pre-opp procedures that a subsequent surgeon advised were unnecessary. Later, I was told that the surgeon's assessment was "not correct," leaving me with conflicting medical opinions from VCA and very little confidence in the accuracy of the information I was receiving.

Throughout this experience, I felt there was little accountability for the communication breakdowns or the consequences they created. As a result, I lost my referring veterinarian, spent unnecessary time and money, and experienced significant disruption to our household. No responsibilty taken by VCA.

I ultimately found a new surgeon. During one interaction, I was told, "I have rules, and if you cannot follow them..." That comment, made while my spouse was listening ultimately led to non-trust in placing our family member with VCA.

Choose wisely!

They get 1 star because it’s clean and nice aesthetic. Only come here if you’re rich, and I mean like “drop $10k” to save your pet kinda rich.
The people at the front desk make fun of your situation and sadness, the front desk people also whisper gossip with each other. It makes me uncomfortable.

The vet doctors are professional and nice.

Dear Doctors and Veterinary team,
I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude for the care, attention, and YOU professionalism  all  of  you showed in treating my dog, Misha on April 24th starting at 3:30 AM.
Your kindness, patience, and dedication made a very difficult time much easier for both of us.
I truly appreciate the effort you put  into his treatment.
Thank you  for your expertise, your gentle approach, and  your genuine concern for your patients.
I would especially like to thank a manager Erin, who was working  that day and helped  me a great deal.
With sincere appreciation,
Yelena Nadell

Every single person I encountered there during a very scary and difficult time due to my dog's health was so incredibly kind, helpful, comforting and authentic. I felt very safe in them caring for my girl overnight for multiple nights. They explained everything thoroughly and empathetically. Could not reccomend this veterinary hospital more! Amazing!

I can be a very unpleasant person when stressed. I came to VCA a few years ago and was pissy about wait times gave them 1star .Because of this went to a different er for surgery when he developed his first tumor. they didn’t do a good job… VCA let me come back after being rude and leaving a nasty review as well as complaining though their customer service process.

I took my baby chappie here for a few surgeries over the couple years he had cancer. They removed one from his back his face and eventually had to amputate his right arm. He was able to become cancer free and surgery’s went successfully.

He didn’t live long after and passed suddenly. I was able to take him to VCA to have him cremated. The team hand wrote me a condolence letter and it was needed. I’ve never lost a friend like that and they were calming through the process even when I got aggressive. Pet ERs can feel like a sales process. I felt comfortable and given options thought his treatments that didn’t make me feel pressured.

One of the last photos of my baby taken the day before he passed.

Thanks for treating cat.

We got a massive shock this year when our 3 year old cat was suddenly diagnosed with aggressive lymphoma. We started treatments with Dr Jeon and were under VCA’s care until August. Dr Jeon and the staff were beyond kind in every way. He would literally find us as we were about to leave the parking lot when he had thought of another idea we could try for treatments. That’s how dedicated, knowledgeable, and compassionate the entire team was. While we unfortunately lost her in August because the lymphoma was extremely aggressive and resistant, Dr Jeon did literally everything possible and gave us 6 precious months with her against all odds. I think of the VCA team every day, and I am so grateful for everything they do. As someone that sat weekly in that lobby for 1-3 hours during treatments, I saw countless other cases enter and witnessed the care and expertise VCA had with every one of them. I am forever grateful to them. During her 6 month battle with cancer we were in numerous vet offices, and of all of them, VCA was by far the most supportive, understanding, and truly incredible.

MANY OTHER REVIEWS WITH THIS EXPERIENCE! I suggest you look for them and read them because they're true. It's been weeks and we still haven't received our blood work results. We kept being told a doctor would call us back and they haven't. We had to have our dog euthanized because she was suffering.... WEEKS. This place is horrid. We want our results NOW.

Edit: while writing this review I've been on hold for 20 minutes at 7:30am....
Compassionate, efficient & knowledgeable! My 16 year old Maltese was treated for a recurring trachea collapse & 4 months later he is still stable & enjoying life🙏🏻

Place is a scam.....theyre friendly but will nickle and dime you also they seem to not really be interested in my dogs care......upwards of 200 for shaving and cleaning a wound......even if i have the care club to which i pay for monthly.......a local vet is cheaper and friendlier..........these people will try and take advantage of your emotions and use them to charge you a whole lot of money..for example they tried to bill me 1200 for a exam.....not worth it....dont buy into the care club thing as its a scam and it doesnt cover anything

Hi there, we're truly sorry that your experience didn’t meet expectations—we understand how important your pet’s care is. Our Hospital Manager would love the opportunity to listen and address your concerns. Please don’t hesitate to reach out at reviews.vcaVetspecialistvalleyca@vca.com—we’re here for you. 💙  …

my dog is sick and it is very emotional for me.Keiana at the front desk treated me so well. she answered my questions and really cared about my problems.  I have been to clinics before and most times I get a blank stare and hassled attitude. keiana stood by me in a very tuff time. give her a promotion and raise

Friendly but didn't seem interested in treating my pet.  Checked in early with no pets in lobby and was told switch over time from night to day so 3 hour or so wait because the doctor had to exam the pets already there. After an hour and a half of waiting in exam room I left took my pet elsewhere where she received fluids and a shot and got excellent care. They seemed not to want me to stay.   When I left the lobby was full.  How they are going to service all the pets is beyond me.  They were closed down awhile back wonder if poor service and pet care had anything to do with it. I would try somewhere else before going to this place.  Unfortunate because they are close by.

We had to rush our 2.5-year-old Boston Terrier to VCA Veterinary Specialists of the Valley + Emergency Service after an ulcer in his eye suddenly ruptured. Their emergency team took us in immediately and cared for him with compassion and professionalism.

Although the visit was quite expensive (as most emergency vet visits are), we’re grateful they were there when we needed them most. The staff was knowledgeable, kind, and kept us updated throughout the process.

I did request that they trim all his nails while he was under anesthesia. Unfortunately, I was disappointed to learn they only managed to trim three paws, which suggests they tried while he was awake and he resisted. This is why I asked multiple times for it to be done while he was fully sedated.

Overall, thank you for taking such good care of our pup when he needed it most. I highly recommend them if you ever face a pet emergency.
I could not be more grateful for everyone at the clinic tonight. They saw my dog quickly and took incredible care of him, even though it ended up being something minor. Thank you VCA!
Terrible place, if you actually have an emergency, don’t come here. They’ll charge you $800 for tests and you’ll never hear from the DR, just receptionists playing broken telephone with you.

We brought our dog to this hospital last night. He had four seizures and past away peacefully this morning. The staff where all helpful, professional and compassionate. He received excellent care at reasonable prices. Thanks to all the staff.
Dr. Chretin was very patient and knowledgable. Worth the wait and the cost.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE!!! They don't care at all about your pet. They just take your money and not give you results. It's now day 4 with no lab results back! My 2 month old puppy is sick and they can careless. No phone calls, no apologies, no customer service or more importantly no care for sick puppy. Worst decision i've made to take my puppy to this horrible pace. They should shut down their business for the way they treat these poor sick animals with no care in the world.
They took care of my Eva immediately and I am thankful.

All they want is money. No compassion. I would have received better assistance if I walked into a McDonald's and asked them to help my dog. I only went here because it's one of the only oncology vets nearby. I was still going to go back after paying almost $2k for an infusion because my dog couldn't start chemo yet. When I called a few days later and asked the doctor to please start Laverdia to tied us over until we could start chemo, they wanted me to come in and pay even more money to dispense the medications when it's an at-home medication to dispense. They wanted me to pay for more blood tests and another UA when she had just had them done 10 days prior at our primary vet. Despite my better judgment I was still going to go here when her biopsy wound healed to start chemo but now NO WAY. I called to ask the doctor a question and they told me my dog isn't his patient because I went back to our primary vet to get the bridge medication so I can SAVE HER LIFE before she could start the chemo. Unless you have hundreds of thousands of dollars and don't care how you are treated, go here. If you want compassion, empathy, and not to be financially raped then tossed out, stay away. I will be getting her chemo injection treatment elsewhere now when she can start. You guys just lost a ton of money you could have squeezed out of me but good riddance. Horrible place. Even the experience going there left me in tears in the parking lot calling my regular vet telling them to just put my dog down because I was so discouraged and felt the darkest energy from this place.

If you love your pet, like LOVE your baby, go someplace else. I don't even want to give them 1 star. Couldn't even answer my question after giving money for an injection I'm not even sure she received. Just because I needed to start working with my primary vet in the interim. This place disgusts me.

I have mixed feelings. My primary vet suggested I take my cat here to meet with an internist. That visit with Dr Chan and his team was great however I needed to follow up and that has been a horrible experience.  I first time I called they put me on hold and after 20 minutes it went to voicemail. I called back in the morning, asked my question and they said someone would get back to me. 5 hours later I called again and was told I would get a return call by the end of the day. No return call!

Staff is very friendly & helpful. Had an emergency visit that unfortunately did not end well but they were communicative the entire time and helped ease the situation as best they could. Highly recommend.
Thank you so much for your review, Maha! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Veterinary Specialists of the Valley—your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …
The friendliest veterinary hospital I have been to. Very clean facilities and offer coffee while you are waiting. Took great care of Tessi

My regular vet on Sundays was closed and I needed to have ER attention for my cat. I was really wavering about this and trying to hold on for another 24 hours to see my regular vet as past experiences made me feel untrustworthy about the care and advice that I would get at one of the 24 hour ER veterinarian clinics. I called several places and got advice from
Other local veterinarians and based my decision on that as well as how the reception staff handled my call. I settled on this VCA as n Woodland Hills. AND I am so glad to have had Dr. Hutchinson today at VCA. The staff were kind. The waiting room was clean and calm. Dr. Hutchinson worked with me on pricing and accommodations for my various options. Never an easy decision! But most of all she was extremely thorough and compassionate. Talking to me for a long time about the details of my cats condition and my options. I am so glad to have an emergency care vet that I can trust and feel that my emotional state is cared for as well! Which is always a thing when you’re dealing with pets in an emergency. Thank you! My baby boy and I are headed home now.
I really think they don’t care here :( they are heartless

Took my French because she suddenly couldn’t walk and was in pain they said 9k for mri and might as well put her down or take her home 500$ with no meds this was almost three years back total experience felt like buying a car these people are sales persons. Our dog went to a vet down the street hours later and saved our dog for less than the visit here crazy I know. To this day our dog is healthy and walking again . Listen to reviews if you dog can wait  till morning go elsewhere.
Thank you for showing such incredible kindness to someone who really needed it today. I will always be grateful for it when I think back on how painful today was. - Pumpkin's mom.

I cannot praise the staff at VCA highly enough. When our beloved cat was terminally ill, they went above and beyond to make his final days comfortable. Their kindness and empathy helped make it much easier on my heartbroken son.

I called VCA to let them know my husband was rushing over with our dog, Shlomo. They assured me they weren't too busy and would be ready to see him upon arrival. I mentioned my husband might seem grumpy due to a brutal migraine and asked …

Amazingly compassionate care.

My cat had an accidental litter (long story) and one of the babies was extremely …
My dog died here today.

I took my dog because he had cancer and it was time to put him to rest. The staff, from the nurses to the vet, were so kind and accommodating. They made this experience so much easier. They set up blankets so we can sit with him, and …

We just took our injured dog to this place. They told us that the wait time is 2 HOURS!!! So we asked to sign in to leave and to come back, as we left our small kids at home. The front office declined our request, she told us that we "Must …

This team is incredible! I was having an emergency with my senior pup at 4 am, and they took us in without hesitation. They were all incredibly empathetic and kind while they quickly got to the bottom of what was going on. Really grateful for the experience and that they’re so close!
